name: Kaladesh
description: Kaladesh is a plane of aether and invention, Chandra's home plane and Saheeli's, whose largest city is Ghirapur.

status.text: The latest events in the material show Huatli's earlier meeting with Saheeli on Kaladesh, while later pages describe the plane as under attack and renamed Avishkar after the revolution.

citations.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
timeline.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
timeline.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
timeline.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
timeline.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Huatli arrives in a bustling inventors' city on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: She emerged into a city unlike any she had seen before.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Saheeli names the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: This plane is Kaladesh, and this city is Ghirapur.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: On her way to the tavern, Huatli runs into Saheeli, whom she met on Kaladesh on her first planeswalk, and rushes off without confessing her feelings.
timeline.quote: "I have to go," Huatli adds, interrupting whatever Saheeli was about to say.

citation.text: "Note for a Stranger" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2022.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
timeline.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Mohar says a powerful mind mage has agreed to help him.
timeline.quote: A powerful mind mage has agreed to lend us his assistance with

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar asks his old friend Rudra, now in the barracks, to help restore Kaladesh by force.
timeline.quote: I need a force to put an end to the race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says no revolution worth having has been bloodless, accepting a bloody trap at the finish line.
timeline.quote: No revolution worth having has ever been bloodless.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.
